title: Reset existing providers and seed new category-specific service providers

requirements.text: Add an admin-only backend operation that deletes/removes all existing Service Provider accounts/data from the canister state (at minimum: providerProfiles entries and their provider role assignment), so that client browsing returns zero providers immediately after the reset.
acceptanceCriteria: When called by an admin, all existing ProviderProfile records are removed from backend storage.
After reset, getProviderResults(category) returns an empty array for any category.
Non-admin callers receive an authorization error (English error message).

requirements.text: Add an admin-only backend operation to seed a new set of service provider entries that are tied to specific service categories so they only appear when clients browse those categories (and do not appear in unrelated categories).

quotes: create a new that will be appearing on specific category of services

acceptanceCriteria: Seeding creates multiple new provider entries with realistic profile fields (name, rate, location, description, verificationStatus, isEngaged/engagementEndTime) and a non-null stored category value.
For each seeded provider, getProviderResults(filterCategory) includes the provider only when filterCategory matches the provider’s stored category.
Seeded providers do not appear in getProviderResults() for non-matching categories.
Seeded providers appear in the “All Providers” mode (category = null) returned by getProviderResults(null) and/or getAllProviders() (whichever is used by the client UI).
Non-admin callers receive an authorization error (English error message).

requirements.text: Add a simple Technical Team (Back-office) UI control that allows an authenticated back-office/admin user to run (1) the provider reset and (2) the provider seeding actions, with clear English confirmation prompts and success/error feedback.

quotes: remove all the service providers and create a new that will be appearing on specific category of services

acceptanceCriteria: The back-office screen shows two clearly labeled actions (e.g., “Delete All Providers” and “Seed Category Providers”).
A confirmation step is required before deleting providers.
On success, the UI shows an English success message and React Query caches related to provider lists/results are invalidated so client pages reflect the new dataset.
If the user is not authorized, the UI shows an English error message explaining they do not have permission to perform the action.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit frontend files under frontend/immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing real provider account creation flows for the seeded providers (e.g., enabling those seeded principals to log in and manage their profiles).
Changing the existing category model or adding new category types beyond using the existing predefined category/businessType mapping.
Adding external databases or third-party admin tooling.
